bench_saying_02: A good place to sit. It always was.
bench_saying_03: The Wisps work quieter when you rest.
bench_saying_04: Someone carved a small leaf here, long ago.
bench_saying_05: The tree breathes slower. So do you.
bench_saying_06: Rest is a kind of tending, too.
bench_saying_07: The wind smells of rain and moss.
bench_saying_08: From here, the clearing looks bigger.
bench_saying_10: Nothing needs you this very moment.
fruit_farewell_01: Go gently. I will grow again.
fruit_farewell_02: You were kind to me. I remember.
fruit_farewell_03: Carry this with you. Come back.
fruit_farewell_05: Again, then. I am not afraid.
fruit_farewell_06: The seed knows the way home.
fruit_farewell_07: Each time, I grow a little wiser.
fruit_farewell_08: Thank you, Keeper. Until the next spring.
wisp_favourite_toast_1: A Wisp has settled in at {node}.
wisp_favourite_toast_2: {node} has a Wisp who loves it now.
wisp_favourite_toast_3: A Wisp hums happily at {node}. It feels at home.
